liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Birdsong** (2 reviews): Reviewer found it beautiful, with jet streams overhead on a summer night in Michigan; Reviewer has heard only this song so far and says it is worth the download [12][21]
- **Iko Iko** (2 reviews): The move from Throwing Stones into Iko Iko gave the reviewer goosebumps; Hornsby played standout accordion on this song, according to the reviewer [10][12]
- **Standing On The Moon** (1 review): A big full moon hung in the sky over the stage during this song [11]

## The recordings

- **gd91-06-20.sbd.aj.2787.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 178 min; rated 3.38/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the audience tape better conveys crowd reaction to the wild start of set two than the soundboard does [13]
- **gd91-06-20.aud.ladner.2187.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 168 min; rated 4.2/5 by 20 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the audience recording as excellent quality; Reviewer calls the audience recording powerful, with Phil very prominent and tuned up in the mix; Reviewer says Phil is strong and clear in the audience recording's mix [11][17][21]
- **gd1991-06-20.149646.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 171 min [7]
- **gd1991-06-20.140466.TSBeyerCM101.ebel.flac2496**: source not stated; 19 songs; 171 min [9]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says someone dosed them with two tabs in the woods between the parking lots before the first set [12]
- From the tenth row, reviewer saw Jerry looking uninterested and annoyed, with the two keyboardists seeming lost [14]
- Reviewer disputes the negative account and says Jerry was well dialed in at this show [15]
- Reviewer says Jerry sat the show out, essentially singing as a backup vocalist, as the night before [18]
- Reviewer calls the second set one of the most unusual in a long time [10]
- Attendee at both Pine Knob shows says this was the better of the two [11]
- Reviewer thinks the band became more erratic after this tour than before it [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-06-20.sbd.aj.2787.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > Cass > DAT > CD > EAC, with Audience patch: Unknown DAUD > CD > EAC [1]. Also: Soundboard went through DAT, cassette, DAT, CD and EAC, with an unknown audience DAT patched in; Ivan Kotch did the editing with EAC, CDWave and SoundForge 4.5; it reached etree via Adam Jerugim [1]
- **gd91-06-20.aud.ladner.2187.sbeok.shnf**: source: unknown mics > DAT > CDR > EAC x 2 > WAV > SHN3.0 [6]
- **gd1991-06-20.149646.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 18, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [7]. Also: An UltraMatrix DAT covers the set-break announcement and the set two tape flips [7]
- **gd1991-06-20.140466.TSBeyerCM101.ebel.flac2496**: taped by Pete Ebel; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac24/96 Source Info: TS Beyer CM 101-> Sony D6-> Cassette Master (Maxell XL-II's 90's). Transfer Info: Master Cassette-> Nakamichi CR-5A -> Grace Lunatec V3… [9]. Also: Recorded with Beyer CM101 microphones; B&K 4011 audio from a GEMS source fills tape flip and cut gaps; Gaps filled include the flip after Maggie's Farm, a cut during Drums, and a deck pause after Not Fade Away [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Music on TIDAL: [Grateful Dead - Download Series Vol. 11: Pine Knob Music Theater, Clarkston, MI 6/20/91 (Live)](https://tidal.com/album/2575433) [25]
- Poster by Philip Andelman Grateful Dead: [1991-06-20 Pine Knob Music Theater, Clarkston, MI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-06-20-pine-knob-music-theater-clarkston-mi-usa/) [26]
- Fan art by photog.com: [Jim Anderson's Grateful Dead Photos Pine Knob 16 & 20 June 1991](https://photog.com/gdead/90s/91/06-19&20/index.html) [27]
